warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender Td4 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The BMW M47D20 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older BMW M47D20 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every BMW M47D20 rebuild.
Because the Defender Td4 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Defender 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established BMW M47D20 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
